grammars.layout_topology: Asymmetric document layout with a narrow evidence rail and long-form service ledger; no centered hero.
grammars.typography: Editorial serif display with compact sans-serif utility text and visible hierarchy shifts.
grammars.density: Medium-high information density with short factual rows instead of promotional cards.
grammars.geometry: Rules, columns, square corners, and measured whitespace; no floating rounded containers.
grammars.imagery: Sparse documentary imagery or source material with captions; never decorative stock mosaics.
grammars.navigation: Masthead index with anchored section labels and one direct contact route.
grammars.interaction: Quiet anchor navigation and evidence disclosure; motion is optional and restrained.
grammars.business_fit: Professional practices whose trust depends on evidence, precision, and clear scope.

grammars.layout_topology: Offset welcome split followed by a sequential care path and low-pressure resource shelf.
grammars.typography: Soft humanist display type paired with highly readable body text and generous line height.
grammars.density: Low-medium density with one decision per section and clear emotional pacing.
grammars.geometry: Open frames, soft section boundaries, and restrained curves used only where they support care.
grammars.imagery: Natural environmental or documentary people imagery with quiet crops and explicit source status.
grammars.navigation: Small top navigation plus visible in-person, remote, and contact paths.
grammars.interaction: Progressive disclosure, reduced-motion-safe transitions, and no urgent conversion pressure.
grammars.business_fit: Trust-sensitive care where visitors need orientation, privacy, and a calm next step.

grammars.layout_topology: Utility-first dispatch board with service-area map, numbered job sequence, and persistent quote panel.
grammars.typography: Condensed utility display type with sturdy sans-serif body copy and numeric emphasis.
grammars.density: Medium-high operational density with phone, area, availability, and proof kept visible.
grammars.geometry: Rectangular panels, heavy rules, stamped labels, and zero ornamental rounding.
grammars.imagery: Real work, tools, vehicles, crews, or before/after evidence; no abstract lifestyle filler.
grammars.navigation: Service and area shortcuts with persistent call or quote action.
grammars.interaction: Fast disclosure of service fit and contact; no decorative motion.
grammars.business_fit: Local services where speed, service area, proof, and a clear request path matter most.

grammars.layout_topology: Image-led canvas with an offset project index and changing full-bleed/contained work rhythm.
grammars.typography: One expressive display face with sparse utility labels and restrained body copy.
grammars.density: Visually dense but text-light; hierarchy comes from scale, crop, and sequencing.
grammars.geometry: Edge-to-edge planes, intentional overlaps, and irregular rhythm rather than repeated modules.
grammars.imagery: Primary authored work is the structure; placeholders must be clearly labeled and replaceable.
grammars.navigation: Compact project index and direct inquiry line; no conventional service-card navigation.
grammars.interaction: Keyboard-safe project focus and optional subtle reveal that honors reduced motion.
grammars.business_fit: Creative work where the portfolio itself should lead and repeated marketing modules would dilute it.

grammars.layout_topology: Workbench layout with a persistent catalog index and product rows that open into a detail bench.
grammars.typography: Compact grotesk or mono utility type with product-name display contrast.
grammars.density: High scannability and medium-high density; products are rows or specimens, not generic cards.
grammars.geometry: Shelves, rows, labels, and squared specimen frames with functional spacing.
grammars.imagery: Product-isolated images, detail crops, packaging, and real scale cues.
grammars.navigation: Category index, product anchors, and explicit order/availability note.
grammars.interaction: Filter or detail reveal with keyboard support; no fake cart or checkout behavior.
grammars.business_fit: Product-led sites where visitors need to scan, compare, and understand availability.

grammars.layout_topology: Date-led bulletin with a changing notice feed and calendar rail, collapsing to a chronological mobile flow.
grammars.typography: Friendly slab or serif headlines with plain sans-serif notices and visible dates.
grammars.density: Medium density with clear chronology and compact recurring notices.
grammars.geometry: Paper-like bands, pins, rules, and offset notice blocks without uniform cards.
grammars.imagery: Community-submitted or event-specific imagery with dates and captions.
grammars.navigation: Topic tabs and date anchors instead of a marketing funnel.
grammars.interaction: Filter notices and reveal event details with progressive enhancement.
grammars.business_fit: Community and event projects where chronology, participation, and local detail lead.
